賃 can refer to a fee, fare, rent, wages or a charge for hiring. The complete word determines the particular payment: [家賃](../words/家賃.md) (やちん) is rent for housing, 運賃 (うんちん) is a passenger fare or freight charge, and 賃金 (ちんぎん) is wages or pay.
代 can mean taking another's place, a generation or era, and a charge or fee.
俸 concerns salary or a stipend, especially pay associated with official duties.
給 concerns giving or supplying something, including money paid for work. In [給料](../words/給料.md)
１ 筋道をきちんと立てたおきて。「紀律／官紀・軍紀・校紀・綱紀・風紀」
"extract": "紀\nキ 紀行，紀元，風紀"

紀 is associated with a chronicle or account. In [世紀](../words/世紀.md) (せいき), the whole compound means a century or, more broadly, an era. The hundred-year unit belongs to 世紀, not to 紀 by itself. JMdict also records 紀 as a suffix for a geological period.
- 紀律 きりつ - a rare kanji spelling of 規律, not the usual spelling
- JMdict marks 紀律 as a rarely used kanji form of 規律. Learn 規律 as the ordinary spelling rather than inferring that the forms are equally common.

[維](../kanji/維.md) contributes holding together or sustaining; [持](../kanji/持.md) contributes holding or keeping. Their related meanings reinforce the idea of keeping something in existence or in its present condition. The on readings are イ + ジ.

KANJIDIC2 lists "fiber," "tie" and "rope" for 維. The meaning of a compound must still be checked as a whole: [維持](../words/維持.md) (いじ) means maintenance or preservation, but that does not establish "maintenance" as a general standalone meaning of 維. 繊維 (せんい) means fiber.

- The character-level senses "tie" and "rope" do not make every compound with 維 a physical cord. In particular, 維持's maintenance sense belongs to the complete word unless separately established for the character.
３ つなぎとめる。「維持」
